reading: The proposal retires one open question, whether the Book 20 hands-to-draw conversion is a lasting settlement or a stage the finale must revisit, as the author's instruction directs (E1, E7). The record shows nothing else changed: the phases still describe hands setting part of draw from Book 20 (E11) and the finale choosing among mechanisms (E12). So the proposal removes the question and not the conversion. Whether the conversion is now treated as settled, or simply not asked about, is not stated.

concerns.title: Whether the Book 20 conversion is revisited in the finale
concerns.earlier: An open question asked whether the conversion is lasting or a stage the finale must revisit.
concerns.proposed: The question is no longer carried among the open questions.
concerns.reading: The author's instruction retires the question, so the concern that the finale might revisit the conversion is no longer recorded as open. The record does not say whether the author means the conversion is settled, or that revisiting it is simply not wanted. This is interpretation.
counterevidence: Phase 5 (E12) still has the finale choose how labour is owed, so the matter may be taken up there.
Phase 4 (E11) still records the conversion as an event, so it is not erased.
concerns.competing_reading: The retirement may mean the conversion is intended as a lasting settlement, with the finale's mechanism choice carrying any later reconsideration under a different question.

concerns.title: The conversion remains part of the Series
concerns.reading: The instruction asks that nothing else change (E1), and phase 4 still says hands set part of draw from Book 20 (E11). The event and its reader experience, the cost of counting, are still represented.

concerns.title: The finale still chooses who gives labour
concerns.reading: Phase 5 still has Book 30 choose among mechanisms for who gives labour and who is counted (E12). That choice stays represented and is separate from the retired question.
counterevidence: The finale mechanism question is a different open question, and the record does not show it was meant to absorb the retired one.

prospective.text: The Book 24 decision The Uncounted Crew (E6) is recorded against the retired question by identity. It says Book 24 makes the conversion concrete without answering it. This is a recorded relationship, not a demonstrated contradiction. Book 25 was listed only by title.

Speculation: with the question retired, the conversion's human cost could be written as a standing condition of the valley, not a pending decision. Book 24 or 25 could then dramatise its consequences without implying a later reversal.

alternatives.title: Keep the retirement as instructed
alternatives.summary: Apply the retirement and leave Book 24's decision and the finale question as they are. Keeps the conversion in the Architecture and q-finale-mechanism open.
alternatives.gains: Follows the author's instruction exactly and changes nothing else.
alternatives.costs: Book 24's decision still refers to a question that is no longer open, and nobody is prompted to check that.
alternatives.next_investigation: Read Book 24's decision and Book 25 to see whether either assumes the conversion can be revisited.

alternatives.title: Carry the revisit concern inside the finale question
alternatives.summary: Speculative: keep the conversion retired as its own question, but note in the finale-mechanism question that each mechanism treats the Book 20 conversion differently.
alternatives.gains: Keeps the interaction between the conversion and the finale visible without a separate question.
alternatives.costs: Edits a question the instruction did not name, and may reintroduce what the author retired.
alternatives.next_investigation: Ask the author whether the retirement means the finale must not revisit the conversion.

alternatives.title: Defer until Book 25 has been read
alternatives.summary: Leave the proposal unapplied while Book 25 is read for decisions on the conversion, since it was listed only by title.
alternatives.gains: Avoids deciding while Book 25's relationship to the question is unknown.
alternatives.costs: Delays the retirement the author asked for.
alternatives.next_investigation: Read Book 25 for any decision tied to the retired question.
